channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Church news: Congregations plan special services
item.description: Wilson-area congregations announce old-fashioned services, revivals, pastoral milestones, Black history observances and Holy Communion services.

item.title: Demons rule as Big East champs after putting away Saints
item.description: Fike boys basketball claimed its first outright conference crown since 1990, beating Southern Wayne 88-69 to secure the 5-A/6-A Big East title and cap a 19-5 regular season.

item.title: Northern Nash avenges earlier loss, drops shorthanded Hunt into second-place tie
item.description: Northern Nash avenged a January loss with a 61-53 win at shorthanded Hunt, dropping the Warriors into a second-place Big East tie and sealing Fike’s 5-A/6-A Big East title.

item.title: Duke is hamstringing progress on energy affordability
item.description: NC’s energy affordability task force softened its report after Duke Energy sought weaker language, while the utility pursues gas plants and pipelines for data centers instead of renewables.

item.title: A decade after reform, NC’s film industry still thrives
item.description: A decade after North Carolina scaled back film subsidies, 2025 productions still spent $185M in-state, undercutting claims that shrinking incentives would end the state’s film industry.

item.title: You Decide: What’s wrong with the job market?
item.description: January’s upbeat jobs report masks a sluggish market, with hiring concentrated in health care and weighed down by AI uncertainty, shifting tariffs and deportations.

item.title: ‘We’re going to figure it out’: Imagination Station charts new course
item.description: Facing financial strain, Wilson’s Imagination Station museum unveils a five-year plan with new vision, revenue goals and community engagement to secure its future.

item.title: Residents speak out with televised public comments
item.description: Wilson City Council's first televised public comments in a decade brought residents’ concerns about Vick Cemetery and high utility bills.

item.title: 2 new Eagles for Troop 6
item.description: Scouts complete community projects to receive Eagle Award.

item.title: Sheriff candidates share platforms at Democratic forum
item.description: At a packed Wilson County Democratic forum, three sheriff candidates outlined plans for tackling property crime, drug-driven offenses, youth violence and boosting school resource officers.
